# YouTube script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## youtube.addModerator

Makes a viewer a moderator of your live YouTube chat. Fails when YouTube is not connected or you are not live.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.addModerator", new { user = "@CoolViewer42" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_add_moderator(user="@CoolViewer42")
    ```

## youtube.addTags

Adds tags to your YouTube broadcast. Tags it already has are kept, and doubles are skipped.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tags` | `tags` | The tags to add, as a list like ["gaming", "chill"] or as text with commas, like "gaming, chill". |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one). |

**Gives back:** The full list of tags the video has now.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.addTags", new { tags = new[] { "gaming", "chill" } });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_add_tags(tags=["gaming", "chill"])
    ```

## youtube.clearTags

Removes every tag from your YouTube broadcast.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one). |

**Gives back:** The list of tags the video has now (empty).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.clearTags");
    ```

=== "Python"


## youtube.createPoll

Starts a poll in your live YouTube chat. It needs a question and 2 to 4 options.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `question` | `question` | The question, like "Which game next?" |
| `options` | `options` | The answers, as a list like ["Minecraft", "Fortnite"] or as text with commas. |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast. |

**Gives back:** The id of the poll message. You can give it to youtube.endPoll.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.createPoll", new { question = "Which game next?", options = new[] { "Minecraft", "Fortnite", "Tetris" } });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_create_poll(question="Which game next?", options=["Minecraft", "Fortnite", "Tetris"])
    ```

## youtube.deleteMessage

Deletes one message from your YouTube chat. Fails when YouTube is not connected or the id is empty.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `messageId` | `message_id` | The id of the chat message, like the %messageId% of a chat trigger. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.deleteMessage", new { messageId = "LCC.abc123" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_delete_message(message_id="LCC.abc123")
    ```

## youtube.endPoll

Ends a YouTube chat poll. Fails when there is no active poll.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pollMessageId` | `poll_message_id` | Optional. The poll id from youtube.createPoll. Leave it out for the poll Cuebot started last. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.endPoll");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_end_poll()
    ```

## youtube.getBot

## youtube.getChannelInfo

Looks up a YouTube channel. Fails when you are not signed in or the channel cannot be found.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |

| `user` | `user` | The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. |

## youtube.getQuota

Shows how much of your daily YouTube allowance (quota) Cuebot has used. YouTube limits how many requests you can make per day.

**Gives back:** An object with used (units used today, an estimate), dailyQuota, exhausted (true when none is left) and resetsAt (when it starts over).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.getQuota");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_get_quota()
    ```

## youtube.sendMessage

Sends a message in your live YouTube chat. Text over 200 characters is split. Fails when YouTube is not connected or you are not live.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `message` | What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!" |
| `useBot` | `use_bot` | Optional. true sends it with your bot account. Leave it out to send as yourself. |
| `fallback` | `fallback` | Optional. With useBot, true (the default) sends as yourself when the bot is not signed in or fails; false makes it fail instead. |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.sendMessage", new { message = "Welcome to the stream!" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_send_message(message="Welcome to the stream!")
    ```

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_send_message_to_latest_monitored(message="Welcome to the stream!")
    ```

## youtube.setCategory

Changes the category of your YouTube broadcast. YouTube uses number ids for categories, like "20" for Gaming.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `categoryId` | `category_id` | The category id, like "20" (Gaming) or "22" (People & Blogs). |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one). |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.setCategory", new { categoryId = "20" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_set_category(category_id="20")
    ```

## youtube.setMetadata

Changes the title, the description, or both, of your YouTube broadcast in one go. What you leave out stays as it is.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | Optional. The new title. Leave it out (or empty) to keep it. |
| `description` | `description` | Optional. The new description. Leave it out to keep it. |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one). |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.setMetadata", new { title = "Chill games with chat", description = "Playing with chat tonight!" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_set_metadata(title="Chill games with chat", description="Playing with chat tonight!")
    ```

## youtube.timeoutUser

Times out a viewer in your live YouTube chat for some seconds. Fails when YouTube is not connected or you are not live.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. |
| `duration` | `duration` | Optional. How long, in seconds, like 300. Leave it out for 300 (5 minutes). |
| `broadcastId` | `broadcast_id` | Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.timeoutUser", new { user = "@CoolViewer42", duration = 300 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_timeout_user(user="@CoolViewer42", duration=300)
    ```

## youtube.unbanUser

Lifts a ban or timeout. YouTube only lets Cuebot undo bans it placed itself since it started; use YouTube Studio for older ones.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently. |

**Gives back:** Nothing. Fails when Cuebot did not ban this viewer in this session.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("youtube.unbanUser", new { user = "@CoolViewer42" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.youtube_unban_user(user="@CoolViewer42")
    ```
